scripts.start: npm run build -w packages/widget && npx dotenv -e .env.local -- npx tsx packages/server/src/local-dev.ts
scripts.start:dev: concurrently --names "widget,server" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run build:dev -w packages/widget" "npx dotenv -e .env.local -- npx tsx watch packages/server/src/local-dev.ts"
scripts.dev: npx dotenv -e .env.local -- npx tsx watch packages/server/src/local-dev.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/widget && npm run typecheck -w packages/server
